taxonomy_reconciliation_explanation.level_of_counting: Entity-level (171 gold, 159 pred) vs Error-event level (paired overlap instances).
taxonomy_reconciliation_explanation.explanation: In strict entity evaluation, every gold entity without an exact match is 1 FN (53 total), and every prediction without an exact match is 1 FP (41 total), giving 94 strict error points. In the error taxonomy, when a prediction overlaps a gold entity with boundary or category error, that single event links 1 FP with 1 or more FNs. Specifically, 35 overlapping predictions account for 35 FPs and 39 FNs (due to compound spans covering multiple golds). Adding 6 spurious FPs (6 FP, 0 FN) and 14 unmasked missed PII (0 FP, 14 FN) perfectly accounts for all 41 FPs and 53 FNs.
